name: Publishes Package
description: An account owns this package, and — when GitHub links the package to a repository — that repository publishes it. Two sources on one edge type: every package has an owner; only some are linked to a repository, and the link is GitHub's, not inferred.

link_kind.description: `owner`: the account the package lives under (always present). `repository`: GitHub's own package-to-repository link, present only when the package was pushed with a source label or linked by hand.
